hero.description: Premium porcelain interiors for Vietnam's most demanding spaces.

origin.heading: Craft born from conviction.
origin.nameStory: In Italian, Perla means pearl — a name chosen for what fine porcelain should feel like in a room: depth beneath the surface, soft radiance, and quiet refinement. Like a pearl formed layer by layer, we believe exceptional interiors are built through patience, precision, and an eye for detail that never settles.
origin.body: Perla, established in 2020 and backed by Hung Phat, a company with over two decades of industry experience since 2004, was founded with a clear vision: to deliver premium ceramic and porcelain surfaces with exceptional craftsmanship, quality, and attention to detail.
origin.imageAlt: Archival photograph of the original Hung Phat workshop in Bat Trang, Hanoi

kiln.label: Origin
kiln.title: Born in Fire
kiln.body: Each tile begins as raw clay and mineral pigment, formed under 1,200°C. The kiln determines everything — density, tone, surface character.
kiln.imageAlt: Ceramic tiles being fired in a high-temperature industrial kiln

polishing.label: Refinement
polishing.title: Worked to Perfection
polishing.body: After firing, surfaces are calibrated, honed, and inspected by hand. Consistency across 10,000 m² is not automated — it is earned.
polishing.imageAlt: Artisan polishing and inspecting large-format ceramic surfaces

installation.label: Responsibility
installation.title: Installed With Intent
installation.body: We plan cutting waste to minimise environmental footprint. Good craftsmanship is inseparable from care for the spaces we build.
installation.imageAlt: Specialist installer laying large-format ceramic tiles with precision

capabilities.heading: A Complete Model for B2B Ceramic Projects

production.title: Custom Production
production.body: Curated collections produced to exact dimensional, tonal, and finish tolerances for each project.

logistics.title: Technical & Logistics Support
logistics.body: Sequenced delivery, substrate coordination, and on-site installation management across complex multi-trade environments.

aftercare.title: Post-Installation Care
aftercare.body: Documented maintenance standards, replacement planning, and long-term surface performance support.

network.title: Scale & Footprint
network.subtitle: Northern Region & Nationwide
network.description: Connecting over 200 partner showrooms and clients across Northern Vietnam, backed by a robust supply chain executing premium projects nationwide. From initial consultation to final inspection, our distribution power ensures prompt delivery and matching specifications for every contract.

craftsmanship.title: Craftsmanship
craftsmanship.description: We treat ceramic surfaces with the same rigor a master sculptor gives to stone. From meticulous cutting and calibration to microscopic alignment audits on-site, every joint is a testament to our decade-long commitment to flawless surface integration.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.description: Premium projects require absolute predictability. Our supply chain features strict quality-control audits, structured timelines, and transparent coordination. We deliver exactly what we promise, on schedule, every single time.

customerCentricity.title: Customer-Centricity
customerCentricity.description: We put your project requirements first. From custom mockups to bespoke technical specifications, we adapt our services to meet the specific demands of developers and architects, backed by a dedicated aftercare support program.

sustainableGrowth.title: Sustainable Growth
sustainableGrowth.description: We design and install with the future in mind. By optimizing material waste allocation, practicing environmental responsibility, and selecting highly durable materials, we create architectural structures that endure for generations.

empire-city.title: Empire City
empire-city.description: A Keppel Land–led joint venture on 14.5 hectares in Thu Thiem — one of Ho Chi Minh City's largest waterfront mixed-use masterplans, with about 3,787 premium apartments planned across residential phases including Linden and Tilia Residences.
empire-city.imageAlt: Empire City mixed-use development overlooking the Saigon River in Thu Thiem

ramada-ha-long-bay.title: Ramada Ha Long Bay View
ramada-ha-long-bay.description: Wyndham-branded hospitality on Ha Long Bay, developed by Lac Hong Construction & Investment. The 33-storey waterfront tower opened in 2019 with 568 serviced apartments beside UNESCO-listed Ha Long Bay.
ramada-ha-long-bay.imageAlt: Ramada by Wyndham Ha Long Bay View hotel and serviced apartments in Quang Ninh

hinode-city.title: Hinode City
hinode-city.description: A Japanese-inspired mixed-use landmark by Vietracimex (WTO) at 201 Minh Khai, Hai Ba Trung. Three 26-storey towers on 2.8 hectares deliver more than 1,100 residences, with handover completed in late 2020.
hinode-city.imageAlt: Hinode City mixed-use residential towers in central Hanoi

vinhomes-symphony.title: Vinhomes Symphony
vinhomes-symphony.description: Vinhomes' low-density riverside ensemble inside Vinhomes Riverside, Long Bien — 4.3 hectares, seven towers of 9–15 floors, and about 1,500 apartments brought into operation from September 2020.
vinhomes-symphony.imageAlt: Vinhomes Symphony apartment towers within Vinhomes Riverside, Hanoi

saigon-intela.title: Saigon Intela
saigon-intela.description: Vietnam's early smart-home apartment community along the Saigon River in Binh Chanh — 1,068 units in two 24-storey towers by Bac Phuoc Kien and LDG Group, with construction completed in 2020.
saigon-intela.imageAlt: Saigon Intela riverside apartment towers on Nguyen Van Linh, Ho Chi Minh City

grand-world-phu-quoc.title: Grand World Phu Quoc
grand-world-phu-quoc.description: Vingroup's 85-hectare "sleepless city" at Phu Quoc United Center, opened 21 April 2021 — a Venice-inspired canal district with 24/7 shopping, dining, and entertainment anchoring Vietnam's island tourism hub.
grand-world-phu-quoc.imageAlt: Grand World Phu Quoc entertainment and retail complex at night
